svg.aria-label: micodigopostal.fun: a search box looks up Arica, Santiago, Puerto Montt, and Punta Arenas in turn; a slot-machine counter rolls to each city's base postal code (1000000, 8320000, 5480000, 6200000) while a pin hops down Chile, drawn sideways from north to south.
